title: Endless Instability
description: This mod changes many stages of Minecraft, adding new blocks, tools, and bosses. It's not yet finished and is in early development. It's 70% translated into English and 100% into Russian.
body: This mod changes many stages of Minecraft, adding new blocks, tools, and bosses. It's not yet finished and is in early development. It's 70% translated into English and 100% into Russian. Discover new elements and study them to uncover the truth hidden by time. Defeat the creations of the ancients to find the one responsible for the creation of this world.
